verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an official MCP server that lets Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other MCP clients query production logs and run evals. It also documents a programmatic API covering experiments, traces and metrics, and a `bt` CLI to browse and query logs, so an agent can investigate trace data to debug an app. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that metrics and eval/experiment results can be queried (not just run) through the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none).
